{{Quote|Something...something's up there."<br />"That would be the Kayven whistlers. Carnivorous fliers. They live up in the rafters – but occasionally we hoist a treat up to them.|[[Orrin Gault]] and [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]]|<ref name="Kenobi (novel)">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>}}
'''Kayven whistlers''' were vicious carnivorous flying creatures, resembling a cross between a monkey and a [[Bat/Legends|bat]]. The magician [[Xaverri]] created illusions of them in her act, flying over and swooping down at the audience. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] kept some kayven whistlers as pets at his townhouse and palace and took great delight in feeding his enemies to them.
